en.title: At Least Two 7s and Divisible by 3
en.description:
Determine whether the integer represented by a digit string is divisible by 3 and the character 7 appears at least twice. Both conditions must hold.

This site has made the standard input and output explicit; any range not given by the source is marked as this site's protocol.
en.input: One line containing a non-empty digit string, which may have leading 0s. The source gives no length bound; on this site the length is 1..1000000.
en.explanation: Example 1: 7+7+1=15 and there are two 7s, so output 1. Example 2: the digit sum is 21 and there are three 7s, so output 1. Example 3: the digit sum 9 is divisible by 3, but there is only one 7, so output 0.
hints: Scan to compute the digit sum and the count of 7s, then check that the digit sum mod 3 is 0 and the count is at least 2.
